They show code where `Sucursal::find($id,'Imagen')` returns a model/JSON object, then `str_replace` is applied incorrectly, so `$datos` becomes the whole object string instead of the file path. Need to summarize the issue for support: file deletion from storage path is failing because the path is being built from the model object instead of the `Imagen` attribute, and the record is deleted from DB but not the physical file.
